name: hackeval
description: Hackathon submission scorer — compares PPTX claims against GitHub reality

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm install --include=dev && npx prisma generate && npm run build

scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
